comment: The presses of a button (1.4, haumacher/ehome #70) are strict inside: the press of an enumeration needs a Zigbee action and presses; presses of a boolean press, of the wrong shape, with an unknown kind, empty, or with elements that are no integers, outside the action's 0..5 or named twice are refused.

refusals.reason: a button with an enumeration press needs presses (which elements are which press)
presses is only for an enumeration press; 'bell' is boolean
an enumeration press needs a Zigbee action datapoint (a client binding), whose elements are known; 'mode' is not one
malformed: presses must be an object of press kinds (press, on, off, up, down, release) to arrays of elements
malformed: on must be a non-empty array of elements
malformed: off must be a non-empty array of elements
malformed: an element must be an integer
element 7 is no element of 'hall.remote' (a Zigbee action: 0..5)
element 1 is a press of on already
datapoint 'count' is unsigned, but the role press of a button takes boolean, controlled or enumeration
